name: @openshapeforge/compiler
description: Compiles OpenShapeForge authoring YAML into database, API, UI and Keycloak artifacts. Runs under Bun; see docs/consuming.md in the repository.
//publishConfig: Published to the GitHub Packages npm registry by .github/workflows/package-compiler.yml on pushes to main (only when this version does not exist there yet — bump `version` to release). The registry pin means a stray `npm publish` from a dev machine cannot land on npmjs.com.
//exports: The entry is the TypeScript source: the package runs under Bun only (docs/consuming.md), and Bun executes .ts directly. `./src/*` stays open because the shipped workflow example plugin deep-imports compiler internals.
//files: src is the runtime — there is no build step. config must ship too: schema-validation.ts resolves config/schemas relative to its own module, so a tarball without it fails on the first authoring validation.
